function: A CNN predicts low-dimensional WMMSE parameters (per-user lambda, per-BS dual variables mu); precoding vectors are rebuilt in closed form for network massive MIMO sum-rate maximization (pp. 7-8).
system: Downlink network massive MIMO, L=3 BSs with M=128 ULA antennas each jointly serving K=60 single-antenna users, perfect CSI, 4.8 GHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 9).
method: CNN (five conv layers, two fully connected, 1.66E7 parameters) trained supervised on WMMSE labels: MSE pretraining, then weighted-MSE refinement; no online retraining (pp. 7-9, Table I).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa 3GPP 38.901 UMa NLoS at 4.8 GHz; 200,000 samples (90% training, 10% validation) over LoS and NLoS, inter-cell distances, random users, labeled by WMMSE (p. 9).
test_conditions: Training mixes LoS/NLoS, inter-cell distances, SNRs; test data disjoint from training; sweeps SNR -10 to 25 dB; UMa/RMa with LoS/NLoS, 100 realizations each (pp. 9, 11).
baselines: Non-learned: converged network WMMSE, normalized network RZF, coordinated WMMSE, RCG-initialized WMMSE. Learned: BLN-PGP of [30], an unfolded parallel gradient projection network (pp. 9-10, Table III).
metrics: Sum-rate in bits per channel use versus SNR; fitting accuracy to WMMSE labels in percent; online and label-generation complexity; iterations to converge (pp. 9-11).
complexity: Online complexity counts in Table III (deep learning 2.62E7 vs WMMSE 4.36E9); 1.66E7 network parameters (Table I); complexity orders in Section V-D (pp. 8, 10).
q1_support: p. 9: "QuaDRiGa model [57] with the scenario set as" 3GPP 38.901 UMa NLoS at 4.8 GHz; p. 11 also tests 38.901 UMa and RMa with LoS and NLoS.
q2_support: p. 9: "under different scenarios, covering both line-of-sight (LoS) and NLoS conditions" describes the training set; p. 11: "under various propagation environments following the 3GPP" UMa and RMa are tested. The paper never states that a test scenario, number of users, antennas, or band was left out of training, and reports no fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 9: "latter iterated until convergence. Algorithm 1 is initialized" (network WMMSE; normalized network RZF and coordinated WMMSE are also compared, all non-learned); p. 9: "in [30], a beamforming learning network" (BLN-PGP, earlier learned precoder); all on sum-rate (Fig. 3, Table III).
q4_support: p. 10: "We also compare the online computational complexity," with orders and counts in Table III (2.62E7 for the proposed method vs 4.36E9 for WMMSE); p. 8, Table I lists 1.66E7 parameters.
q5_support: p. 9: "a supervised neural network training is generated according" to the authors' Algorithm 2 with QuaDRiGa; the 200,000-sample dataset is self-generated, and no link or DOI to code or data is given.
notes: Included, area 3 (precoder design for network massive MIMO, CNN supervised on WMMSE labels). q1 rests on QuaDRiGa with 3GPP 38.901 (UMa NLoS by default, UMa and RMa with LoS and NLoS in Table IV, p. 11). q2 is 0 because the paper does not state that any test scenario was excluded from training: p. 7 says the training data use 'various propagation environments' and p. 9 says the set covers different scenarios, LoS and NLoS. Fig. 5 shows K=40 and K=60 and p. 10 says inputs are zero-padded when K is smaller than 60, but it is not stated that the K=60 model was tested at K=40; the reviewer may re-check. q3: the learned baseline is BLN-PGP [30], configured as in its original implementation (p. 9). q5 is 0: QuaDRiGa is a public simulator but the dataset is self-generated and not released; the reviewer may confirm.
